blockingFindings.title: R1 marker and priority excerpt coverage is incomplete
blockingFindings.issue: R1 requires requirement excerpts to include priority when present and an explicit testing-not-required marker only when testable is false, but the tests only assert id/desc and omission of unrelated spec text. There is no assertion for priority rendering, testable:false marker rendering, or marker absence for testable requirements.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add spec-local assertions covering priority in the excerpt, the testing-not-required marker when testable is false, and absence of that marker when testable is not false.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: An acceptance requirement has no corresponding executable coverage, while the coverage artifact marks R1 as covered.

blockingFindings.title: R4 fallback regex assertions are not executable as written
blockingFindings.issue: The R4 test builds RegExp objects with `replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\{{PROMPT}}")`. For fixture text containing regex metacharacters, this creates invalid or nonsensical regex patterns instead of escaping the original text.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Use a valid regex escaping replacement such as `replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&")`, or avoid RegExp and assert with `includes` for the full spec text and full diff.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: The test is not reliably executable and can fail before exercising the target API behavior.
